title: An arXiv preprint that Semantic Scholar types as a journal article lost its preprint flag

found.context: Stage D paper-mode run of the demo project against the live indexes

observed_failure: A 2026 arXiv paper came back from Semantic Scholar with publicationTypes JournalArticle and venue arXiv.org, so is_preprint() said no and the source was not flagged preprint.
expected_behavior: A record is a preprint when any sign says so: the arXiv index, a preprint type, a repository source, a preprint server named as the venue, or a preprint-server DOI prefix.

resolution.summary: is_preprint also reads the venue and the DOI prefix

lessons: Index type labels are not reliable for preprints; check the venue and DOI too.
